home.hero_subtitle: Huza SIM card zawe kugira ngo ubone indangamuntu ya digitale itekanye, yihariye kandi ishobora kugenzurwa mu minota mike.
home.feature_1_desc: Amakuru yawe bwite aguma kuri network. Dukoresha gusa ibimenyetso by'icyizere.
home.feature_2_desc: Ongera amanota y'icyizere uhuza SIM card zigera kuri 3 zo kuri network iyo ari yo yose yo muri Afurika.
home.feature_3_desc: Banki, amavuriro n'imiryango itari iya leta bishobora kugenzura VID yawe ako kanya hakoreshejwe kode ya QR.

enroll.title: Iyandikishe muri VID
enroll.subtitle: Injira muri network itekanye y'umwirondoro wa digitale.
enroll.has_id_question: Ufite ubwoko runaka bw'indangamuntu usanzwe ukoresha?
enroll.has_id_description: Indangamuntu y'igihugu, pasiporo, cyangwa uruhushya rwo gutwara. Kubishyiramo byongera amanota y'icyizere.
enroll.phone_error_invalid: Shyiramo nomero irimo kode y'igihugu urugero: +250788123456
enroll.consent_text: Nushyira akamenyetso mu gasanduku kari hasi, uba uhaye VID uruhushya rwo gusaba ibimenyetso bya network (ituze rya SIM, guhuza KYC, n'aho uherereye) ku batanga serivisi za telefone kugira ngo hemezwe umwirondoro wawe.
enroll.consent_privacy: Ndasobanukiwe ko nta makuru yanjye bwite y'umwimerere azabikwa kuri server za VID.
enroll.consent_required: Ugomba gutanga uruhushya kugira ngo ukomeze
enroll.location_title: Kongera icyizere ukoresheje aho uherereye (Si ngombwa)
enroll.location_description: Emeza aho uherereye neza kugira ngo wongere urwego rw'icyizere rwa VID yawe.
enroll.location_share: Sangiza aho uherereye ubone bonus ya +4
enroll.location_verified: Aho uherereye hemejwe kugira ngo icyizere cyiyongere!
enroll.timeout_message: Igihe cyo kwiyandikisha cyarangiye. Ongera ugerageze.
enroll.loader_subtitle: Turimo gufungura ibimenyetso bya CAMARA Network
enroll.loader_description: Turimo kugenzura ituze rya SIM yawe, guhuza kwa KYC, n'aho uherereye dukoresheje abatangiye serivisi bo mu karere.
enroll.loader_timing: Ubusanzwe iki gikorwa gifata amasegonda 15-20 kugira ngo network igenzurwe mu buryo butekanye.

verification.title: Umwirondoro wemejwe
verification.subtitle: Network ID Nyafurika yizewe
verification.info_desc: Iri genzura rishingiye ku bimenyetso bya ako kanya bitangwa n'abatanga serivisi za telefone. Urwego rw'icyizere rugaragaza amahirwe y'uko umwirondoro wa nyirayo ari uw'ukuri.

pdf.title: VID - Icyemezo cya Virtual ID
pdf.watermark: Guteza imbere umwirondoro wa digitale wa Afurika binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga rya telefone

errors.server_error: Ikosa rya server. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.
